description: This source file contains MIPS assembly code for configuring the SRAM clock settings and DRAM start/size functions specific to Realtek RTL839X hardware. It includes low-level register manipulations to adjust PLL and clock rates, with conditional compilation based on the CONFIG_RTL839X flag.

methods.name: rtcl_839x_dram_start
methods.description: Label for starting the DRAM initialization routine in assembly.

methods.name: rtcl_839x_dram_set_rate
methods.description: Function to set the DRAM clock rate, involving hardware register manipulations, conditional on CONFIG_RTL839X.

methods.name: rtcl_839x_dram_size
methods.description: Symbol representing the size of DRAM memory, placed immediately after the start label.
